page_title: TOU 2-1 ETI | Toulouse v St Etienne 13/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Ayman Aiki (St Etienne) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
90+4' Dangerous play by Dylan Batubinsika (St Etienne). Thomas Leonard blows his whistle for a foul.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Substitution. Zakaria Aboukhlal will be replaced by Denis Genreau (Toulouse).
90' Here is a change. Aron Donnum is going off and Carles Martinez gives the last tactical orders to Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse).
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lamine Fomba (St Etienne) comes onto the pitch for Pierre Cornud.
89' A substitution has been made. Pierre Ekwah goes off and Florian Tardieu (St Etienne) comes on.
89' Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
87' Thomas Leonard sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
86' Wait! Referee Thomas Leonard has indicated he is going to review the Toulouse goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

85' 2 - 1 Goal! Niklas Schmidt swings the ball deep into the box and finds Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper low into the middle of the goal. 2:1.
84' St Etienne have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
78' Carles Martinez prepares a substitution. Vincent Sierro is replaced by Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse).
78' Substitution. Frank Magri (Toulouse) has come on for Joshua King.
76' Substitution. Ibrahim Sissoko (St Etienne) replaces Lucas Stassin.
76' Olivier Dall'Oglio has decided to make a change. Ayman Aiki (St Etienne) replaces Zuriko Davitashvili.
76' The resulting set piece from Toulouse is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
68' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
64' Substitution. Mathis Amougou (St Etienne) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Louis Mouton walks off.
63' The foul by Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Thomas Leonard.
61' Lucas Stassin (St Etienne) has too much to say to the referee and is cautioned.
61' Dennis Appiah (St Etienne) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Thomas Leonard ignores the protests.
60' Carles Martinez has decided to substitute Shavy Babicka and he is replaced by Yann Gboho (Toulouse).
58' Pierre Ekwah (St Etienne) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.

55' 1 - 1 A perfect lofted pass from Gabriel Suazo finds Shavy Babicka (Toulouse), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header into the right side of the goal. His effort was both strong and precise, and Gautier Larsonneur had no chance of stopping that. 1:1.
53' 0 - 1 Goal! Dennis Appiah plays a pass to the feet of Lucas Stassin (St Etienne), and he shoots into the bottom right corner from inside the box. It's 0:1.
53' A pass from Joshua King (Toulouse) is intercepted by Gautier Larsonneur and the move breaks down.
49' Joshua King (Toulouse) receives a yellow card.
49' The yellow card is received by Yunis Abdelhamid (St Etienne).
48' Thomas Leonard couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Louis Mouton (St Etienne) and blew his whistle.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
43' Louis Mouton (St Etienne) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Guillaume Restes intercepts the ball.
42' Joshua King (Toulouse) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
40' Pierre Cornud (St Etienne) is penalised for holding. Thomas Leonard signals a set piece.
40' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
40' The free kick is delivered by Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared. St Etienne get a corner.
38' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
36' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) wasted a chance to score! He pinged a fine header from deep inside the box towards the net, but his aim was off and it flew narrowly wide of the right post.
35' Thomas Leonard blows his whistle. Yunis Abdelhamid (St Etienne) commits a foul after dangerous play.
33' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
33' Thomas Leonard blows his whistle for a foul after Pierre Ekwah (St Etienne) hacks down one of his opponents.
30' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
27' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
26' It looks like Aron Donnum (Toulouse) saw red with that tackle. Thomas Leonard won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
25' Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
23' Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
23' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
22' Dennis Appiah (St Etienne) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
19' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Thomas Leonard didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
18' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
13' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
12' Joshua King (Toulouse) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
11' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
10' Thomas Leonard shows a yellow card to Benjamin Bouchouari (St Etienne), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
10' St Etienne take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
8' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Thomas Leonard blows his whistle for a foul.
6' Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) is afforded space inside the box after collecting a pass, but the chance is wasted as his shot goes harmlessly over the crossbar.
5' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
2' Thomas Leonard has a clear sight and sees a foul from Pierre Cornud (St Etienne).
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
St Etienne will kick the game off.
Thomas Leonard is introduced as the referee for today's match.
